reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new one, takes its categories from shouldFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories and its sign from averageToBudgetAmount, reusing getSheetValue/setBudget/getCategoryAverage.

duplication.why: The four copied selection queries and income guards are removed; what remains repeated is the `includeHiddenCategories ? 'include' : …` mapping at each action.

placement.why: The selection rule, template/#fixed checks and sign helper sit in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them; the handler is registered in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the selection refactor, the new action, the flag and release notes.

maintainability.why: One definition with the existing hidden-handling difference made explicit as a named mode; minor warts are reusing averageToBudgetAmount for last-month spending and the per-action flag-to-mode mapping.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending all go through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the old copies were removed rather than reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories take a hiddenMode parameter whose 'include' value (one extra branch) carries the includeHiddenCategories flag; template and #fixed rules are added as general conditions, and no action bypasses the definition.
